stories.title: The Creation
stories.summary: God creates the heavens, the earth, and living creatures over six days. The account ends with God resting on the seventh day.

stories.title: The Fall of Man
stories.summary: The serpent persuades the woman to eat from the forbidden tree, and the man also eats. God confronts them, announces consequences, and sends them out of Eden.

stories.title: Cain and Abel
stories.summary: Cain kills his brother Abel. God confronts Cain and sends him away from the ground he cultivated.

stories.title: The Line of Seth
stories.summary: The genealogy traces the line from Adam through Seth to Noah. Enoch walks with God, and Noah is introduced with his three sons.

stories.title: Noah and the Flood
stories.summary: Noah builds an ark to preserve his household and animals through the flood. Afterward, God establishes a covenant with Noah and living creatures, with the rainbow as its sign.

stories.title: The Family of Noah
stories.summary: Noah’s sons and their descendants are named after the flood. The genealogy describes peoples, languages, and lands.

stories.title: The Tower of Babel
stories.summary: People build a city and tower to make a name for themselves and avoid being scattered. God confuses their language and scatters them across the earth.

stories.title: The Call of Abram
stories.summary: Abram’s family leaves Ur for Haran. God calls Abram to another land, and he travels to Canaan with Sarai and Lot.

stories.title: Abram and Lot
stories.summary: Abram and Lot separate their households. Lot settles near Sodom, and Abram later rescues him after a battle.

stories.title: Hagar and Ishmael
stories.summary: Sarai gives Hagar to Abram, and Hagar conceives. After fleeing mistreatment, Hagar encounters the angel of the Lord and returns; Ishmael is born.

stories.title: Abraham and Sarah’s Covenant
stories.summary: Abram and Sarai receive the names Abraham and Sarah. God promises a son named Isaac, and visitors announce his coming birth.

stories.title: Lot Leaves Sodom
stories.summary: Visitors warn Lot to leave Sodom with his family. The chapter recounts the cities’ destruction and the origins of Moab and Ben-ammi.

stories.title: Isaac and Ishmael
stories.summary: Sarah gives birth to Isaac. Hagar and Ishmael leave Abraham’s household, and God provides water for them in the wilderness.

stories.title: The Binding of Isaac
stories.summary: God tells Abraham to offer Isaac. A messenger stops Abraham, and a ram is offered in Isaac’s place.

stories.title: Isaac and Rebekah
stories.summary: Abraham’s servant travels to his master’s relatives to seek a wife for Isaac. Rebekah agrees to leave with him and marries Isaac.

stories.title: Jacob and Esau
stories.summary: Isaac and Rebekah’s sons grow up with different roles. Esau sells his birthright, Jacob receives Isaac’s blessing, and Jacob leaves for Paddan-aram.

stories.title: Jacob’s Household
stories.summary: Jacob reaches Laban’s household and marries Leah and Rachel. Their household grows through children born to Leah, Rachel, Bilhah, and Zilpah.

stories.title: Jacob Returns to Canaan
stories.summary: Jacob leaves Laban, wrestles through the night and receives the name Israel. He meets Esau and settles near Shechem.

stories.title: Dinah at Shechem
stories.summary: Shechem violates Dinah and seeks to marry her. Her brothers Simeon and Levi attack the city, and Jacob fears retaliation.

stories.title: The Death of Rachel
stories.summary: Jacob returns to Bethel. Rachel dies giving birth to Benjamin, and the chapter lists Jacob’s twelve sons and recounts Isaac’s death.

stories.title: Joseph and His Brothers
stories.summary: Joseph’s dreams and his father’s favour stir conflict with his brothers. They sell Joseph, and he is taken to Egypt.

stories.title: Judah and Tamar
stories.summary: Tamar seeks offspring after Judah fails to give her his son Shelah. Judah acknowledges her claim, and she gives birth to Perez and Zerah.

stories.title: Joseph in Egypt
stories.summary: Joseph serves in Egypt, is imprisoned, and interprets dreams. Pharaoh appoints him to store grain before a famine.

stories.title: Joseph Reunites His Family
stories.summary: Joseph’s brothers come to Egypt for food. Joseph reveals his identity, and Jacob’s household moves to Egypt.

stories.title: Jacob Blesses His Family
stories.summary: Jacob blesses Joseph’s sons and addresses his own sons before his death. The book closes with Joseph’s reconciliation with his brothers and his death in Egypt.

stories.title: Israel Oppressed in Egypt
stories.summary: Jacob's descendants multiply in Egypt until a new king enslaves them and orders the Hebrew midwives to kill newborn boys. The midwives refuse, and Pharaoh then commands that the boys be thrown into the Nile.

stories.title: The Birth and Rescue of Moses
stories.summary: A Levite woman hides her baby for three months, then places him in a basket among the reeds by the riverbank. Pharaoh's daughter finds him, his sister arranges for his own mother to nurse him, and he becomes the princess's son and is named Moses.

stories.title: Moses Flees to Midian
stories.summary: Moses kills an Egyptian who was beating a Hebrew, learns the deed is known, and flees to Midian. There he defends the daughters of Reuel at a well, marries Zipporah, and has a son, while God hears Israel's groaning in Egypt.

stories.title: The Burning Bush
stories.summary: At Horeb, God speaks to Moses from a bush that burns without being consumed and sends him to bring Israel out of Egypt. Moses raises objections, is given signs, and Aaron is appointed to speak for him.

stories.title: Moses Returns to Egypt
stories.summary: Moses leaves Midian with his family and the staff of God. During a dangerous encounter with the LORD on the journey, Zipporah circumcises her son. Aaron meets Moses, and the people of Israel believe the signs.

stories.title: Moses and Aaron Before Pharaoh
stories.summary: Pharaoh refuses to let Israel go and increases the labor by making them gather their own straw. The foremen blame Moses, and God renews his promise to deliver Israel and to bring them to the land sworn to the patriarchs.

stories.title: The Plagues of Egypt
stories.summary: Through nine plagues, from the Nile turned to blood to darkness over the land, Moses and Aaron confront Pharaoh. Egypt's magicians match the first signs, then fail; Pharaoh's heart repeatedly hardens and he bargains over who may leave.

stories.title: The Passover and the Death of the Firstborn
stories.summary: God announces the death of Egypt's firstborn and gives Israel the Passover instructions: a lamb, blood on the doorposts, and unleavened bread. At midnight the firstborn die, and Pharaoh sends Israel out as Egyptians give them silver, gold and clothing.

stories.title: The Exodus from Egypt
stories.summary: Israel leaves Rameses, taking the bones of Joseph, with the firstborn consecrated to the LORD. A pillar of cloud by day and fire by night guides the people.

stories.title: Crossing the Sea
stories.summary: Pharaoh pursues Israel to the sea. The waters divide for Israel to cross on dry ground and return over the Egyptian army. Moses and Miriam lead the people in songs of praise.

stories.title: Bitter Water, Manna and Quail
stories.summary: Israel finds bitter water at Marah, which is made sweet, and then grumbles for food in the wilderness. Quail arrive in the evening and manna in the morning, with a double portion of manna gathered before the Sabbath.

stories.title: Water from the Rock and the Battle with Amalek
stories.summary: At Rephidim the people quarrel over water, and Moses strikes the rock at Horeb. Amalek attacks; Israel prevails while Moses's hands are held up by Aaron and Hur.

stories.title: Jethro Advises Moses
stories.summary: Jethro brings Moses's wife and sons to the camp, praises the LORD, and sees Moses judging the people alone. He advises appointing capable men over thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens to hear lesser cases.

stories.title: The Covenant and Ten Commandments at Sinai
stories.summary: Israel camps before Mount Sinai and is told to prepare. The LORD descends in fire and speaks the Ten Commandments to the people, who fear and ask Moses to speak to them instead.

stories.title: The Covenant Is Sealed at Sinai
stories.summary: Moses reads the book of the covenant to the people, who agree to obey, and seals the covenant with blood. Moses, Aaron and the elders ascend the mountain; Moses then enters the cloud and remains on the mountain for forty days and nights.

stories.title: The Golden Calf
stories.summary: When Moses delays, Aaron makes a golden calf and the people feast and play before it. Moses breaks the tablets, the Levites strike down about three thousand, and Moses pleads for the people.

stories.title: Moses Sees God's Glory
stories.summary: The LORD says he will not go in Israel's midst, then relents. Moses asks to see his glory, is placed in a cleft of the rock, and receives a second set of tablets; his face shines afterward.

stories.title: Building the Tabernacle
stories.summary: The people bring more than enough materials, and Bezaleel and Aholiab oversee the work. The tabernacle is set up on the first day of the first month in the second year, and the cloud and glory of the LORD fill it.
